purpose: determine the MAXIMUM DEFENSIBLE claim level for the candidate contribution, conservatively

levels.justification: unconditionally safe; the audit itself is an investigation
safe for the SYSTEM as a proposal; proposing a combination of known components is a proposal, not a novelty claim

defensible ONLY if scoped to the specific unoccupied combination (a learned GT-free predictor of the PAIRED refinement gain used as a PRE-EXECUTION gate within shared multi-domain medical segmentation with preservation-fallback). The word 'novel' must not attach to the gate concept, the paired-gain target, multi-domain modelling, or resource awareness individually — each is occupied (see phase23_prior_art_matrix.csv).

levels.template: To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to ...
levels.justification: NOT supported: (i) the mechanism is precedented in metareasoning (1991), cascades (2001/2021) and treatment-effect meta-learners (2019); (ii) the problem framing exists in segmentation (moon2024jfs, ICIP 2025); (iii) no legal/systematic search has been performed. 'First' cannot be asserted on a single-session index search.

recommended_maximum_scope: a novel UNIFIED SYSTEM: a pre-execution, GT-free, benefit-aware gate for an optional refinement in shared multi-domain medical segmentation, supervised by the paired refinement gain, with preservation-fallback
recommended_conservative_default: Level 1 with a Level-2 sentence scoped strictly to the unoccupied combination
forbidden_phrasings: first to predict refinement benefit in segmentation
reason_for_conservatism: Falsification-first search surfaced a same-framing segmentation paper (JFS), a 1991 formalisation of value-of-computation, a 2021 cascade gating method with cost, and a 2019 paired-gain meta-learner framework. Any of these alone collapses a Level-3 claim.
